title: Great ideas but having problems ⚠️
body: The google keep app is the best note  taking app I have used so far and I have had a great experience with it on my Samsung tab because of the way it arrange all the work. It's amazing but when I moved to the iPhone 11pro. It turned all my notes into checklists and these are hundreds of notes. When I tried to rectify one by one by clicking on the three dots, the app just crashed! I tried it again and the same thing happens more than ten times. In all those tries, I restarted my phone, even deleted and reinstalled the app but all was in vain. It just didn't work and now I am stuck with all these notes that are now checklists. It's sad and hope they can rectify this because I just can't move my notes to any other app :(

author: WhitegoldEmpire

title: Best Note Taking App But...
body:
I have been a Google Keep user for three years now. Keep’s best calling card is that it is FREE and as long as you have a gmail account, it does not matter what phone you use, you automatically migrate with all your notes as soon as you sign in and download Keep on that phone. 

Keep has replaced my moleskin. 

But I cannot for the life of me figure out why the Keep tech team has never made it easier to search in your notes for specific details. I would love to be able to search for say Coffee in my notes and receive bold options wherever I have written about coffee in my notes. Right now all I get is the list of notes that I wrote about coffee in but cannot open the note and be led directly to the bit where I wrote about coffee. I have to scroll and scroll until I find it myself in that note. 

I hope this is fixed soon. 

Keep is a...er...keeper app.
